ai_summary: AIA Engineering reported flat sales volumes for Q2 and H1 FY27, coupled with a slight decline in EBITDA and PAT primarily due to significantly increased export freight costs that impacted operating margins. While management expressed internal confidence in achieving 25,000-30,000 metric tons of annual growth from FY28 and remains bullish on their "game-changing" NGDS trials, these trials are elongated and the growth target is not yet formal guidance. The continued pressure from freight costs, flat current volumes, and uncertainty around trial outcomes are material concerns.
